part1.title: Your AI Writes Boring Stuff? Let It Interview You #shorts
part1.description:
One-line prompts get generic answers. Add one line: "Before you write, ask me 5 questions, one at a time." Then set the tone and length.
An original animated AI tip by zylo.

Follow for one AI trick a day.

#ai #chatgpt #aitips #productivity #shorts
